name: get_protein_tissue_expression
description: Retrieve protein tissue expression information based on a given gene name. Use this tool when you need to find out where a specific protein is expressed in different tissues. Do NOT use this tool for retrieving general protein information or sequence data; for that, use 'get_uniprot_protein_info'.

parameters.name: gene_name
parameters.description: The official gene symbol for the protein of interest, following standard nomenclature (e.g. 'TP53'). Must be a valid gene name recognized in the relevant databases.

parameters.name: include_normal_tissues
parameters.description: Whether to include expression data from normal tissues. Set to true to get a comprehensive view of expression across normal tissues. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: include_disease_tissues
parameters.description: Whether to include expression data from diseased tissues. Set to true to include this data. Defaults to false.

gene_name.description: The gene name provided in the request, confirming the target protein.

tissue_expression.description: List of tissues with corresponding expression levels. Each item includes: tissue_name (string), expression_level (number, scaled 0-100).

normal_tissues_included.description: Indicates if normal tissue expression data was included in the response.

disease_tissues_included.description: Indicates if disease tissue expression data was included in the response.

return_schema.description: Object containing the gene name, tissue expression data, and flags indicating which types of tissues were included.
